dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple circular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings exhibit sharp, high-contrast perimeters transitioning from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light grey interior gradients, most prominent along the upper dorsal-lateral ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate spatial density of solid light-toned, asymmetrical pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, scattered primarily on the lateral flanks surrounding the ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' shaped annuli form a scalene triangle on the upper dorsal surface, while secondary clusters of blobs form an elongated, irregular polygon relative to the primary rings.
